response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 19 years of experience and strong systems thinking, he fundamentally lacks the specialized expertise required for this Principal Performance Architect role. His career has been rooted in web/application development, microservices, and full-stack engineering rather than hardware architecture, semiconductor design, or silicon-level optimization. The role demands deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architectures, deep-learning accelerator optimization, and hardware-software co-design—none of which appear in his professional history. His recent AI infrastructure work appears software-focused rather than hardware-acceleration focused.
strengths: 19 years of proven software engineering excellence with experience optimizing high-performance systems handling millions of concurrent requests
Demonstrated low-level systems programming capability (C/C++, D language) and infrastructure expertise across multiple domains
Strong problem-solving foundation and ability to operate across diverse technical stacks, indicating potential for domain learning
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling, semiconductor design, or hardware architecture—core requirements for this role
Career trajectory focused entirely on application and web software, not hardware-software co-design or silicon-level performance optimization
Lacks specific expertise in GPU architectures, neural network accelerator design, SIMD/MIMD systems, and hardware performance analysis methodologies

key_factors.factor: No SoC/IP modeling or accelerator design experience
Strong foundational engineering and performance optimization skills
